why: Grazing eland in sunlit grassland with a leafy background; source explicitly tags Taurotragus oryx. Less imposing than an alert bull; dimensions and precise location unverified.

why: Photographer explicitly identifies common eland in Lake Mburo National Park, Uganda. Standing animals in lush green habitat; useful full-body alternative, although sex is not confirmed.
